sentences.text: The patient is a 57-year-old female, and your records contain 12 source reports dated between 1995-08-13 and 2021-11-07.

Your records list active conditions including diabetes, hypertriglyceridemia, metabolic syndrome X, hypertension, diabetic retinopathy associated with type II diabetes mellitus, nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus, neuropathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus, chronic kidney disease stage 1, and diabetic renal disease.

For creatinine (a kidney test), the latest value was 2.3 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, which is above the usual range of 0.6-1.2 mg/dL, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went up from 1.7 to 2.2 and then 2.3 mg/dL.

For eGFR (how well the kidneys filter blood), the latest value was 32.8 mL/min/1.73m2 on 2021-11-07, which is below the usual range of above 60 mL/min/1.73m2, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went down from 43.5 to 34.5 and then 32.8 mL/min/1.73m2.

For LDL cholesterol (often called 'bad' cholesterol), the latest value was 140.7 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, which is above the usual range of below 100 mg/dL, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went up from 120 to 122.1 and then 140.7 mg/dL.

For total cholesterol, the latest value was 227.6 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, which is above the usual range of below 200 mg/dL, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went up from 208.8 to 209 and then 227.6 mg/dL.

For blood sugar (glucose), the latest value was 112.3 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, which is above the usual range of 70-99 mg/dL, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went up from 104.8 to 107.4 and then 112.3 mg/dL.

For triglycerides (a type of blood fat), the latest value was 157.5 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, which is above the usual range of below 150 mg/dL, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went from 171.1 to 178.9 and then 157.5 mg/dL.
The other test results did not raise an alert.
Blood-pressure screening is normal, with the latest reading being 132/86 on 2021-11-07, which is below 140/90.
Anaemia screening is normal, with a haemoglobin level of 13.6 g/dL on 2018-10-21, which is at or above 12 g/dL.

Your ongoing medications include lisinopril 10 MG Oral Tablet, Hydrochlorothiazide 25 MG Oral Tablet, and insulin human isophane 70 UNT/ML / Regular Insulin Human 30 UNT/ML Injectable Suspension [Humulin].
No allergies are recorded in the supplied records.

sections.title: Points to discuss with your doctor

sentences.text: You may want to ask your doctor about the trends in your kidney function tests, such as creatinine and eGFR.
You can also discuss your cholesterol and blood sugar levels, and how to manage your ongoing conditions.
